overview_description.description: Farther is a wealth management company that combines financial advisory services with a proprietary technology platform designed to support investment management, financial planning, and tax optimization. The company provides clients with a centralized system for viewing and managing financial accounts, documents, portfolios, and cash management activities in one place. Farther offers services that include portfolio management, retirement planning, estate planning, business planning, and access to private market investment opportunities through its advisory and asset management teams. Its platform is designed to help advisors automate administrative processes, improve operational efficiency, and deliver customized investment strategies supported by data and analytics. The company also works with high-net-worth individuals, families, entrepreneurs, and institutions by providing integrated financial planning and investment management services tailored to varying levels of financial complexity.

about_short_description.short_description: Farther is an intelligent wealth platform that enhances wealth management for clients throughout their financial lives.

product.name: Farther Intelligent Wealth Platform
product.description: A technology-enabled wealth management platform that centralizes financial information, planning, portfolio management, tax optimization, cash management, documents, and collaboration with advisors and other professionals.

product.name: Investment and Portfolio Management
product.description: Personalized investment advisory and portfolio management based on a client’s goals, risk tolerance, time horizon, tax circumstances, and liquidity needs.

product.name: Farther Asset Management
product.description: Farther’s proprietary asset management platform providing research-driven portfolio strategies, tax-aware design, direct indexing, dynamic asset allocation, and access to alternative investments.

product.name: Financial Planning
product.description: Personalized financial planning that models trade-offs among spending, saving, investing, and other financial decisions to align resources with current and future goals.

product.name: Tax Optimization
product.description: Year-round portfolio tax management using tax-loss harvesting, asset location, trade analysis, and other tax-aware investment techniques to improve after-tax outcomes.

product.name: Farther Family Office
product.description: An integrated wealth management service for ultra-high-net-worth families combining investment management, tax and estate strategy coordination, alternative investments, and multi-generational planning.
